title: Ugin | Planeswalker
description: Read Ugin, The Spirit Dragon's biography: an ancient planeswalker seeking to understand the mysteries of the multiverse.

paragraphs.text: Over his unfathomably long life, Ugin has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces, and been reborn at least twice. He's as cunning and powerful as his twin, Nicol Bolas, but luckily much less interested in world domination.
